description: The NDP Construction Pipeline is the Irish government's database of infrastructure projects committed under the National Development Plan 2025. The collection page read on 2026-09-28 (last updated 21 September 2026) says the pipeline sets out the scale, type and location of projects, builds on the sectoral investment plans departments published in late 2025, and gives information by sector and geographic location supplied by the responsible departments and bodies, to support workforce planning and delivery; it is updated periodically. The 2026 pipeline is offered for download, and the earlier Project Ireland 2040 capital tracker (from 2017) and MyProjectIreland interactive map (from 2019), which it replaces, remain available as files last updated in 2025. Coverage is Ireland. Access is free download; the file formats and reuse terms were not read. Caveats: some projects are at a very early stage and schedules may change, and the page asks users to contact departments for details. It supports capacity planning studies, such as mapping planned water, transport and energy assets onto hazard zones. No related Irish capital programme record is catalogued.
